snippet.title: Jaafar Jackson & Jermajesty at Phantasialand Germany | Taron Roller Coaster Ride & Interview 2016
snippet.description:
Phantasialand, Germany – Jackson Family Visit (July 2016)

Jaafar Jackson and Jermajesty Jackson (sons of Jermaine Jackson and nephews of Michael Jackson) visited Phantasialand amusement park in Germany.

In a post-ride interview after experiencing the Taron roller coaster, they described it as their first European theme park visit. They highlighted the ride’s powerful second launch, high speed, and intense turns, calling the experience “amazing” and “insane”. Jaafar mentioned he had never screamed so much on any ride before.

Note: On 11 May 1996, their uncle Michael Jackson had visited the same park and inaugurated the “Colorado Adventure – The Michael Jackson Thrill Ride”.

snippet.title: Rare Look Inside Michael Jackson’s Private Recording Studio | Prince Jackson
snippet.description:
Prince Jackson Gives Rare Tour of Michael Jackson’s Private Home Recording Studio! 👑
This is Michael Jackson’s personal home studio at the iconic Hayvenhurst Estate in Encino, California.

Michael created and recorded many demos, ideas, and songs for Off The Wall, Thriller, and Bad right here between the late 1970s and 1988. The studio remains completely untouched — preserved exactly as he left it, with all the original analog equipment still in place.

Prince Jackson shows the exact white machine from his father’s famous photos and shares a heartfelt message: To the world, these are “memorabilia,” but for him… “It’s just my dad’s studio.” ❤️

A rare and emotional glimpse into where the King of Pop created his magic! ✨

snippet.title: Golden HIStory MJ Statue Unveiled in Changsha by Moffett, Batten & Original Band |MJ HIStory Statue
snippet.description:
Michael Jackson HIStory Golden Statue Unveiled in Changsha, China

On May 3, 2026, the Original HIStory Tour Band officially unveiled a stunning golden Michael Jackson HIStory Statue in Changsha, China. Leading the emotional moment was Jonathan “Sugarfoot” Moffett — the legendary drummer who performed with Michael Jackson throughout the entire HIStory World Tour and many other iconic projects — standing alongside guitarist Jennifer Batten, vocalist Kevin Dorsey, and internationally acclaimed Michael Jackson tribute artist Rodrigo Teaser.

The ceremony took place following a special screening of the Michael biopic in Changsha. A dramatic red curtain dropped to reveal the life-sized golden statue in the classic HIStory album pose, as fans cheered wildly and Michael’s music filled the auditorium. Jonathan Moffett captured the spirit perfectly, writing that “standing there with the original HIStory Tour band brought everything full circle.”

This powerful tribute from China’s dedicated Michael Jackson fan community (MJJCN) — now the 16th golden HIStory statue placed across the country — is yet another beautiful reminder that Michael Jackson’s legacy continues to inspire generations worldwide.

Michael Lives Forever. 🕺✨
